title: HEXAS De Coena Domini Annotatio I open §.I: Why Priores — unde Schismatis initium
pass_a_gloss: HEXAD OF ANNOTATIONS ON THE PRIOR PROTESTANT CONTROVERSIES CONCERNING THE LORD’S SUPPER, WHENCE THE BEGINNING OF THE SCHISM. ANNOTATION I. On the Sense of the words of Institution of the Sacred Supper — whether proper, or figurative? §. I. Why the Protestant Controversies on the Lord’s Supper are called Priores by our Author, he himself not obscurely hints when he adds: whence the beginning of the Schism.
pass_b_english: Here begins the Hexad of Annotations on the earlier Protestant fights over the Lord’s Supper — the place where the schism took its start.
ANNOTATION I asks whether the Institution words of the Sacred Supper are to be taken properly or figuratively.
§. I. Our author himself shows why he calls those Supper controversies Priores when he adds the clause: whence the beginning of the Schism.
source_text:
HEXAS ANNOTATIONUM IN CONTROVERSIAS PROTESTANTICAS PRIORES
DE COENA DOMINI, UNDE INITIUM SCHISMATIS,
ANNOTATIO I
De Sensu verborum Institutionis Sacrae Coenae, proprio ne, an figurato?
§. I.
Cur Controversiae Protestanticæ de Coena Domini, Autori nostro Priores dicantur, ipsemet haud obscurè subinnuit, quando subjicit: unde Schismatis initium.

lemmas.gloss: whence the beginning of the Schism
